data.name: Forutan
data.long_meaning: The name Forutan is derived from the Persian word 'Farhad-e-Rutan', which means 'the wind of Farhad'. In Persian mythology, Forutan is the name of the wind that carried the beloved of Farhad, the legendary hero, to his eternal rest. This name is believed to signify the power and strength of the wind, as well as the renewal and transformation it brings.
